questions.questionEn: A 2-year-old girl is brought to the ambulance at 02:00 with a harsh barking cough that woke her from sleep. Her parents report a runny nose for the past two days. HR 132, RR 30, BP 92/60, SpO2 95% on room air, temperature 37.9°C. She has inspiratory stridor when she cries but not at rest, is alert, is not drooling, and is swallowing her own secretions normally. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.questionZh: 凌晨 2 点，一名 2 岁女童因粗哑的犬吠样咳嗽（barking cough）被家长抱上救护车，咳嗽把她从睡梦中惊醒。家长说她前两天开始流鼻涕。HR 132，RR 30，BP 92/60，室内空气下 SpO2 95%，体温 37.9°C。哭闹时可听到吸气性喘鸣（inspiratory stridor），安静时没有；患儿清醒，没有流涎，能正常吞咽自己的分泌物。最可能的诊断是什么？

options.zh: Croup（喉气管支气管炎，俗称假性吼）
Foreign body airway obstruction（气道异物梓阻）

questions.explanationEn: A barking cough that starts at night after a two-day coryzal prodrome, with a low-grade fever and stridor only on crying, is classic croup. Epiglottitis is excluded: it produces a high fever over hours, drooling, a muffled voice and no barking cough, and this child is swallowing her secretions normally. Bronchiolitis is excluded: it is a lower-airway illness of infants producing expiratory wheeze and crackles, not a barking cough with inspiratory stridor. Foreign body airway obstruction is excluded: the onset was gradual over two days after an upper respiratory infection, not sudden while eating or playing. Nothing abnormal is stated about her air entry or her work of breathing at rest, so treat those as normal.
questions.explanationZh: 夜间发作的犬吠样咳嗽、发病前有两天流涕的前驱感冒症状、低热，且喘鸣只在哭闹时出现，这是典型的 croup。Epiglottitis（会厌炎）可以排除：会厌炎在数小时内出现高热、流涎、声音发闷，且没有犬吠样咳嗽，而本例患儿能正常吞咽分泌物。Bronchiolitis（毛细支气管炎）可以排除：它是婴幼儿的下气道疾病，表现为呼气性哮鸣音和湿啰音，而不是犬吠样咳嗽加吸气性喘鸣。Foreign body airway obstruction（气道异物梓阻）可以排除：本例是在上呼吸道感染之后两天内逐渐起病，而不是进食或玩耍时突然发作。题干没有提到安静时的进气量或呼吸做功异常，按官方出题规律，没写出来的就当作正常处理。

questions.questionEn: A 4-year-old boy became unwell 6 hours ago. He is sitting bolt upright, leaning forward on his hands, drooling onto his shirt and refusing to lie down. His voice is muffled, he has no cough, and there is soft inspiratory stridor. HR 152, RR 32, BP 96/62, SpO2 93% on room air, temperature 39.4°C. Which condition is he most likely suffering from?
questions.questionZh: 一名 4 岁男童 6 小时前开始不适。他直挺挺地坐着，双手撑床前倾，口水流到衣服上，拒绝躺下。说话声音发闷，没有咳嗽，可听到轻微的吸气性喘鸣。HR 152，RR 32，BP 96/62，室内空气下 SpO2 93%，体温 39.4°C。他最可能患的是哪一种疾病？
questions.explanationEn: Onset over hours with a high fever, drooling, the tripod position, a muffled voice and an absent cough is epiglottitis: supraglottic swelling makes swallowing painful and the airway is precarious. Croup is excluded: it builds over days, causes a barking cough with a low-grade fever, and does not cause drooling. Bacterial tracheitis is excluded: it follows several days of a croup-like illness and produces a brassy cough with thick purulent secretions, neither of which he has. Peritonsillar abscess is excluded: it usually occurs in older children and adolescents after days of sore throat, with trismus and unilateral tonsillar swelling, and it rarely produces stridor. Keep him upright and calm, do not examine his throat, do not lie him down, and transport.
questions.explanationZh: 数小时内起病、高热、流涎、三脚架体位（tripod position）、声音发闷、无咳嗽，这一组合指向 epiglottitis（会厌炎）：声门上区肿胀使吞咽疼痛，气道随时可能失守。Croup 可以排除：它在数天内逐步加重，表现为低热加犬吠样咳嗽，不会引起流涎。Bacterial tracheitis（细菌性气管炎）可以排除：它通常紧接在数天的类 croup 病程之后，伴金属样咳嗽和大量脓性分泌物，本例两者都没有。Peritonsillar abscess（扁桃体周围脓肿）可以排除：它多见于年长儿童和青少年，前面有数天咐痛，伴张口困难和单侧扁桃体肿大，很少产生喘鸣。处理上要让患儿保持坐位、尽量安抚，不要检查咽部，不要让他躺下，尽快转运。

questions.questionEn: A 21-day-old infant has had a runny nose and cough for three days and is now feeding poorly. RR 66 and shallow with nasal flaring and intercostal indrawing, HR 168, SpO2 91% on room air, temperature 37.6°C. Auscultation reveals bilateral fine crackles with expiratory wheeze. The parents report two brief episodes in which he stopped breathing for several seconds. His heart sounds are normal and his liver is not enlarged. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.questionZh: 一名出生 21 天的婴儿流涕、咳嗽已三天，现在吃奶变差。RR 66、浅快，伴鼻翼扇动和肋间隐降，HR 168，室内空气下 SpO2 91%，体温 37.6°C。听诊发现双肺细湿啰音并伴呼气性哮鸣音。家长说他有两次短暂停止呼吸、每次持续数秒。心音正常，肝脏不大。最可能的诊断是什么？

options.zh: Congenital heart failure（先天性心脏病导致的心力衰竭）

questions.explanationEn: A three-day coryzal prodrome followed by diffuse crackles and wheeze, tachypnea, poor feeding and apnoeic pauses in an infant under two months is bronchiolitis; apnoea is a recognized and dangerous presentation at this age. Croup is excluded: croup is an upper-airway illness producing a barking cough and inspiratory stridor, and this infant has lower-airway findings with no stridor. Congenital heart failure is excluded: it would typically present with a murmur, hepatomegaly and sweating with feeds rather than an infectious prodrome, and the profile states the heart sounds are normal and the liver is not enlarged. Foreign body aspiration is excluded: a 21-day-old cannot self-feed or reach objects, and the onset here was gradual over three days.
questions.explanationZh: 三天的感冒前驱症状，随后出现弥漫性湿啰音和哮鸣音、呼吸得快、吃奶变差，并且在不足两个月的婴儿身上出现呼吸暂停，这是 bronchiolitis（毛细支气管炎）；呼吸暂停是这个月龄段公认且危险的表现。Croup 可以排除：它是上气道疾病，表现为犬吠样咳嗽和吸气性喘鸣，而本例是下气道体征且无喘鸣。Congenital heart failure（先心病心力衰竭）可以排除：它典型表现是心杂音、肝脏肿大、吃奶时出汗，而不是感染前驱；且题干明确写了心音正常、肝脏不大。Foreign body aspiration（异物吸入）可以排除：21 天大的婴儿既不能自己进食也拿不到物体，而且本例是三天内逐渐起病。

questions.questionEn: An 18-month-old was eating peanuts when he suddenly began coughing and gagging. He is now quiet and frightened but alert, RR 40 with mild suprasternal indrawing, HR 138, BP 94/58, SpO2 94% on room air, temperature 36.8°C. Air entry is decreased over the right chest and normal on the left. He has had no cough, fever or runny nose in the preceding days. Which condition is he most likely suffering from?
questions.questionZh: 一名 18 个月大的男婴在吃花生时突然开始咳嗽、干呕。现在他安静但害怕，神智清醒，RR 40，伴轻度胸骨上窝隐降，HR 138，BP 94/58，室内空气下 SpO2 94%，体温 36.8°C。右侧胸部进气量减弱，左侧正常。之前几天他没有咳嗽、发热或流鼻涕。他最可能患的是哪一种疾病？

options.zh: Foreign body airway obstruction（气道异物梓阻）

questions.explanationEn: A sudden choking episode while eating, in a previously well child, with unilaterally decreased air entry, is a foreign body lodged in the right main bronchus. Croup is excluded: there is no barking cough, no stridor and no coryzal prodrome, and croup findings are never unilateral. Asthma is excluded: it produces bilateral expiratory wheeze rather than one quiet hemithorax, and there is no history of wheeze or atopy. Bronchiolitis is excluded: it requires a viral prodrome and produces bilateral crackles and wheeze. Because he is still coughing and moving air this is a partial obstruction: encourage him to cough, do not perform blind finger sweeps, and escalate to back blows and chest thrusts only if the obstruction becomes complete.
questions.explanationZh: 一个原本健康的孩子在进食时突然呛到，随后出现单侧进气量减弱，这是异物卡在右主支气管。Croup 可以排除：没有犬吠样咳嗽、没有喘鸣、没有感冒前驱症状，而且 croup 的体征不会是单侧的。Asthma（哮喘）可以排除：哮喘表现为双侧呼气性哮鸣音，而不是单侧胸腔变安静，且无哮喘或过敏史。Bronchiolitis（毛细支气管炎）可以排除：它需要病毒感染前驱，且体征是双侧的。因为他还能咳嗽、还有气流，属于不完全梓阻：鼓励他用力咳嗽，不要盲目挖取异物，只有在变成完全梓阻时才升级为拍背和胸部冲击。

questions.questionEn: A 5-year-old has had a barking cough and hoarseness for three days. Today she has deteriorated sharply: temperature 39.8°C, HR 160, RR 40, BP 94/60, SpO2 90% on room air. She has stridor at rest and a brassy cough, and is bringing up thick purulent secretions. She is not drooling and is able to lie flat. Nebulized epinephrine given by a first responder produced no improvement. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.questionZh: 一名 5 岁女童犬吠样咳嗽和声嗰已三天。今天病情急剧加重：体温 39.8°C，HR 160，RR 40，BP 94/60，室内空气下 SpO2 90%。安静时即有喘鸣，咳嗽呈金属样，并咳出大量黏稠的脓性分泌物。她没有流涎，也能平躺。急救员先前给予雾化 epinephrine 后病情毫无改善。最可能的诊断是什么？
questions.explanationEn: A croup-like illness that suddenly worsens with a high fever, a toxic appearance, copious purulent secretions and no response to nebulized epinephrine is bacterial tracheitis, a bacterial superinfection of the trachea in which sloughed membrane obstructs the airway. Croup is excluded: it rarely produces a temperature near 40°C, and it does respond to nebulized epinephrine, so the failure to respond is the discriminating finding. Epiglottitis is excluded: she can lie flat, she is not drooling and she still has a cough, all of which argue against supraglottic swelling. Anaphylaxis is excluded: there is no allergen exposure, no urticaria and no angioedema, and the illness has been building over three days rather than minutes.
questions.explanationZh: 一个类 croup 的病程突然恶化，伴高热、中毒貌、大量脓性分泌物，且对雾化 epinephrine 没有反应，这是 bacterial tracheitis（细菌性气管炎），即气管继发细菌感染，脱落的伪膜阻塞气道。Croup 可以排除：croup 很少烧到接近 40°C，而且它对雾化 epinephrine 是有反应的，“用了没用”正是关键鉴别点。Epiglottitis（会厌炎）可以排除：她能平躺、没有流涎、还保留咳嗽，这三点都不支持声门上区肿胀。Anaphylaxis（过敏性休克）可以排除：没有过敏原接触史，没有荞麻疹或血管性水肿，而且病程是三天而不是几分钟。

questions.questionEn: Which single finding most reliably distinguishes epiglottitis from croup in a child with stridor?
questions.questionZh: 在一名伴有喘鸣的儿童身上，哪一项体征最可靠地将 epiglottitis（会厌炎）与 croup 区分开？

options.zh: 安静时就存在的吸气性喘鸣

questions.explanationEn: Drooling with refusal to swallow reflects painful supraglottic swelling and is the discriminating sign; children with croup swallow their secretions normally. A hoarse voice occurs in both, because both involve the larynx. Inspiratory stridor at rest occurs in both and only tells you the obstruction lies above the thoracic inlet, not what is causing it. Fever occurs in both: what discriminates is the height and speed of onset (high and over hours in epiglottitis, low-grade and over days in croup), not the presence of fever itself.
questions.explanationZh: 流涎并拒绝吞咽反映的是声门上区肿胀带来的吞咽疼痛，这是真正的鉴别体征；croup 的孩子能正常吞咽自己的分泌物。声音嗑哑两者都有，因为两者都累及喉部。安静时的吸气性喘鸣两者也都有，它只能告诉你梓阻位于胸廓入口以上，并不能告诉你病因。发热两者同样存在；真正有鉴别价值的是发热的高度和起病速度（会厌炎是数小时内高热，croup 是数天内低热），而不是发热本身。

questions.questionEn: A 3-year-old with eczema and two previous episodes of wheezing has had 12 hours of cough and audible wheeze. Temperature 36.9°C, HR 140, RR 44, BP 90/58, SpO2 92% on room air. There is bilateral expiratory wheeze in all fields, no stridor, no barking cough, no drooling and no history of choking. Which diagnosis and which PCP treatment plan is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 3 岁患儿有湿疹史及两次哮喘发作史，本次咳嗽并可听到哮鸣已 12 小时。体温 36.9°C，HR 140，RR 44，BP 90/58，室内空气下 SpO2 92%。双肺各野均可闻呼气性哮鸣音，无喘鸣，无犬吠样咳嗽，无流涎，无呛咀史。下列哪一项的诊断和 PCP 处理方案是正确的？

options.en: Croup — give nebulized epinephrine and dexamethasone
options.zh: Croup——给予雾化 epinephrine 和 dexamethasone

options.en: Epiglottitis — do not examine the throat and transport immediately
options.zh: Epiglottitis（会厌炎）——不检查咽部，立即转运

options.en: Foreign body airway obstruction — begin back blows and chest thrusts
options.zh: Foreign body airway obstruction（气道异物梓阻）——开始拍背和胸部冲击

options.en: Asthma exacerbation — salbutamol, with ipratropium as a single dose if severe, and consider dexamethasone
options.zh: Asthma（哮喘）急性发作——给 salbutamol，严重时加用单剂量 ipratropium，并考虑 dexamethasone

questions.explanationEn: Bilateral expiratory wheeze with no stridor in an atopic child with prior wheezing episodes is an asthma exacerbation. The BC shortness of breath protocol directs salbutamol at all licence levels, with ipratropium added at PCP level as a single-dose administration (only salbutamol may be repeated), and dexamethasone considered. Option A has the wrong diagnosis: croup produces a barking cough and inspiratory stridor, neither of which is present, even though dexamethasone is genuinely indicated for croup. Option B has the wrong diagnosis: he has no fever, no drooling and no muffled voice. Option C has the wrong diagnosis and a harmful treatment: there is no choking history and his wheeze is bilateral, so airway-obstruction manoeuvres would delay the bronchodilator he needs.
questions.explanationZh: 一个有过敏体质、之前发过哮喘的孩子，现在双侧呼气性哮鸣且无喘鸣，这是 asthma（哮喘）急性发作。BC 的 SOB 协议规定所有执照级别都可用 salbutamol，PCP 额外可加用 ipratropium（只能给单剂量，只有 salbutamol 可以重复给药），并可考虑 dexamethasone。A 项诊断错了：croup 表现为犬吠样咳嗽和吸气性喘鸣，本例两者都没有，尽管 dexamethasone 确实是 croup 的适应症。B 项诊断错了：患儿不发热、不流涎、声音也不发闷。C 项不仅诊断错了，处理也有害：既无呛咀史，哮鸣又是双侧的，做梓阻手法只会延误他真正需要的支气管扩张剂。

questions.questionEn: A 10-year-old with known asthma remains in severe respiratory distress after two salbutamol treatments and one dose of ipratropium: RR 34, marked accessory muscle use, SpO2 89% on high-flow oxygen, BP 104/66, HR 136. He is awake and following commands, maintains his own airway and is not vomiting. A crew member suggests applying CPAP. Which statement is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 10 岁哮喘患儿在两次 salbutamol 和一剂 ipratropium 后仍处于严重呼吸窘迫：RR 34，辅助呼吸肌明显参与，高流量氧下 SpO2 89%，BP 104/66，HR 136。他清醒、能遵从指令、能自主维持气道，没有呕吐。同事建议上 CPAP。下列哪一项正确？

options.en: CPAP is indicated because he meets all three physiological criteria (RR > 24, SpO2 < 94% on oxygen, accessory muscle use)
options.zh: 可以上 CPAP，因为他同时满足三项生理标准（RR > 24、吸氧下 SpO2 < 94%、辅助呼吸肌参与）

options.en: CPAP is contraindicated because asthma is not a condition for which CPAP may be considered
options.zh: CPAP 禁忌，因为 asthma 不属于可考虑 CPAP 的病种

options.en: CPAP is contraindicated because he is 12 years of age or younger
options.zh: CPAP 禁忌，因为他年龄在 12 岁及以下

options.en: CPAP is contraindicated because his systolic blood pressure is below 90 mmHg
options.zh: CPAP 禁忌，因为他的收缩压低于 90 mmHg

questions.explanationEn: The BC CPAP guideline restricts CPAP to patients 13 years of age and older, and lists patients 12 years and under as an explicit contraindication, so age alone settles it. Option A is the trap: he genuinely does meet all three physiological criteria, but meeting the indications never overrides a listed contraindication. Option B misstates the guideline, which lists asthma among the conditions for which CPAP may be considered in eligible patients. Option D is factually wrong: his systolic BP is 104 mmHg, well above the 90 mmHg threshold. For this child the protocol directs intramuscular epinephrine for severe bronchospasm unresolved by salbutamol, with assisted ventilation by bag-valve mask and a PEEP valve if he deteriorates.
questions.explanationZh: BC 的 CPAP 指引规定 CPAP 只用于 13 岁及以上患者，并把“12 岁及以下”列为明确禁忌，所以单凭年龄就能定案。A 项是陷阱：他确实同时满足三项生理标准，但“满足适应症”永远不能凌驾于禁忌之上。B 项曲解了指引：asthma 恰恰被列入可考虑 CPAP 的病种之一（针对符合年龄的患者）。D 项事实错误：他的收缩压是 104 mmHg，远高于 90 mmHg 的阀值。对这名患儿，协议指引的是对 salbutamol 无效的严重支气管痉挛给予肌注 epinephrine，若患儿恶化则改用 BVM 辅助通气并加接 PEEP 阀。

questions.questionEn: A 24-year-old man developed shortness of breath about 10 minutes after eating at a restaurant. HR 124, RR 30, BP 88/54, SpO2 92% on room air, temperature 36.7°C. He has wheeze throughout both lung fields, raised itchy welts over his chest and arms, and swelling of his lips. He has no history of asthma and takes no medications. Which condition is he most likely suffering from?
questions.questionZh: 一名 24 岁男性在餐厅用餐约 10 分钟后出现气促。HR 124，RR 30，BP 88/54，室内空气下 SpO2 92%，体温 36.7°C。双肺各野均可闻哮鸣音，胸部和双臂出现隐痒的隐疹，口唇肿胀。他无哮喘史，也没有在服任何药物。他最可能患的是哪一种疾病？
questions.explanationEn: Exposure to a probable food allergen followed within minutes by wheeze, urticaria, angioedema and hypotension meets all three BC anaphylaxis criteria: signs of anaphylaxis, exposure to an allergen, and an unstable feature (BP below 90 mmHg with respiratory distress). Asthma is excluded: it does not produce urticaria, lip swelling or hypotension, and he has no asthma history. Pulmonary embolism is excluded: it causes pleuritic pain and hypoxia without any skin findings, and no venous thromboembolism risk factor is described. Spontaneous pneumothorax is excluded: it produces unilateral absent air entry rather than bilateral wheeze with skin findings. Position him supine, do not walk him, remove the allergen, and give epinephrine.
questions.explanationZh: 接触可疑食物过敏原后几分钟内出现哮鸣、荞麻疹、血管性水肿和低血压，同时满足 BC anaphylaxis 协议的三项标准：有 anaphylaxis 体征、有过敏原接触、且处于不稳定状态（BP 低于 90 mmHg 并伴呼吸窘迫）。Asthma（哮喘）可以排除：哮喘不会引起荞麻疹、口唇肿胀或低血压，且他没有哮喘史。Pulmonary embolism（肺栓塞）可以排除：肺栓塞表现为胸膜性疼痛和低氧，不会有皮肤体征，且题干未提供任何静脉血栓风险因素。Spontaneous pneumothorax（自发性气胸）可以排除：气胸是单侧呼吸音消失，而不是双侧哮鸣加皮肤体征。处理：他平卧、不要让他走动、清除过敏原，并给予 epinephrine。

questions.questionEn: A 17-year-old tall, thin male develops sudden sharp right-sided chest pain and breathlessness while sitting watching television. HR 110, RR 26, BP 118/74, SpO2 93% on room air, temperature 36.6°C. Air entry is absent over the right upper chest and normal on the left, the trachea is midline and his neck veins are flat. There is no wheeze, no rash and no fever. Which condition is he most likely suffering from?
questions.questionZh: 一名 17 岁、身材高瘦的男性坐着看电视时突发右侧尖锐性胸痛并气促。HR 110，RR 26，BP 118/74，室内空气下 SpO2 93%，体温 36.6°C。右上胸呼吸音消失，左侧正常；气管居中，颈静脉不怕。无哮鸣音，无皮疹，无发热。他最可能患的是哪一种疾病？
questions.explanationEn: Sudden pleuritic chest pain with unilaterally absent air entry in a tall, thin young male at rest is a primary spontaneous pneumothorax, caused by rupture of an apical bleb. Asthma is excluded: it produces bilateral wheeze, and he has no wheeze at all. Anaphylaxis is excluded: there is no allergen exposure, no urticaria, no angioedema and no hypotension. Pulmonary embolism is excluded: it can cause sudden pleuritic pain and hypoxia, but it does not silence one hemithorax, and no risk factor such as immobility, recent surgery, malignancy or prior clot is described — anything abnormal would have been stated. His midline trachea, flat neck veins and normal blood pressure tell you it is not yet a tension pneumothorax, which must be reassessed continually.
questions.explanationZh: 年轻、高瘦的男性在安静状态下突发胸膜性疼痛，并出现单侧呼吸音消失，这是原发性 spontaneous pneumothorax（自发性气胸），由肺尖肺大疱破裂引起。Asthma（哮喘）可以排除：哮喘是双侧哮鸣，而他根本没有哮鸣音。Anaphylaxis（过敏性休克）可以排除：既无过敏原接触，也无荞麻疹、血管性水肿或低血压。Pulmonary embolism（肺栓塞）可以排除：肺栓塞确实可以突发胸膜性疼痛并伴低氧，但它不会让一侧胸腔呼吸音整个消失，而且题干没有给出制动、近期手术、恶性肿瘤或既往血栓等任何风险因素——异常一定会写出来。气管居中、颈静脉不怕、血压正常说明尚未发展为张力性气胸，但必须持续重评。

questions.questionEn: An 82-year-old woman wakes at 03:00 unable to breathe. She has needed three pillows to sleep for the past week and her ankles are swollen. HR 118 and irregular, RR 32, BP 178/102, SpO2 87% on room air, temperature 36.8°C. She has fine crackles to the mid-zones bilaterally, distended neck veins, and is coughing pink frothy sputum. She takes furosemide and has no history of asthma or COPD. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.questionZh: 一名 82 岁女性凌晨 3 点因喘不上气而惊醒。过去一周她必须垫三个枕头才能入睡，双踝浮肿。HR 118 且不规则，RR 32，BP 178/102，室内空气下 SpO2 87%，体温 36.8°C。双肺中野以下可闻细湿啰音，颈静脉怡张，并咳出粉红色泡沫痰。她在服 furosemide，无 asthma 或 COPD 病史。最可能的诊断是什么？

options.zh: Acute cardiogenic pulmonary edema（急性心源性肺水肿）

questions.explanationEn: Waking at night unable to breathe, after a week of worsening orthopnea and ankle swelling, with bilateral crackles, distended neck veins and pink frothy sputum, is acute cardiogenic pulmonary edema. COPD exacerbation is excluded: she has no COPD history, the findings are crackles rather than the quiet chest and expiratory wheeze of COPD, and orthopnea with a raised JVP is a cardiac pattern. Pneumonia is excluded: she is afebrile, her crackles are bilateral rather than focal, and the onset was abrupt overnight rather than over days with purulent sputum. Pulmonary embolism is excluded: it does not produce raised neck veins with bilateral crackles and pink frothy sputum, and there is no pleuritic pain or leg finding. Sit her upright with her legs hung down, keep her at rest, bring the equipment to her, and give oxygen to keep SpO2 at or above 94%.
questions.explanationZh: 夜间被憋醒、前一周端坐呼吸逐渐加重并伴踝部水肿，加上双肺湿啰音、颈静脉怡张和粉红色泡沫痰，这是急性心源性肺水肿。COPD 急性加重可以排除：她没有 COPD 病史，体征是湿啰音而不是 COPD 那种呼吸音低弱加呼气性哮鸣，且端坐呼吸加颈静脉怡张是心源性的模式。Pneumonia（肺炎）可以排除：她不发热，啰音是双侧弥漫而非局限性，且起病是一夜之间而不是数天病程加脓痰。Pulmonary embolism（肺栓塞）可以排除：肺栓塞不会同时造成颈静脉怡张、双肺湿啰音和粉红色泡沫痰，且无胸膜性疼痛或下肢体征。处理：让她坐起、双腿下垂，保持静止，把设备搬到她身边，给氧使 SpO2 ≥ 94%。

questions.questionEn: A 58-year-old man with a 40 pack-year smoking history has had three days of increasing breathlessness and a productive cough with green sputum. HR 104, RR 26, BP 142/84, SpO2 88% on room air (his baseline is 90%), temperature 37.8°C. He has a barrel chest, purses his lips when he exhales, and has quiet breath sounds with scattered expiratory wheeze. His jugular venous pressure is not raised and his ankles are not swollen. Which diagnosis and which additional PCP intervention is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 58 岁男性有 40 包年吸烟史，三天来气促逐渐加重，咳嗽并咳出绿色脓痰。HR 104，RR 26，BP 142/84，室内空气下 SpO2 88%（他的基础值是 90%），体温 37.8°C。桶状胸，呼气时缩唇，呼吸音低弱并散在呼气性哮鸣音。颈静脉压不高，双踝不肿。下列哪一项的诊断和 PCP 额外处置是正确的？

options.en: Acute cardiogenic pulmonary edema — apply CPAP at 5 cmH2O
options.zh: Acute cardiogenic pulmonary edema（急性心源性肺水肿）——上 CPAP，从 5 cmH2O 开始

options.en: Anaphylaxis — give intramuscular epinephrine, then salbutamol
options.zh: Anaphylaxis（过敏性休克）——先肌注 epinephrine，再给 salbutamol

options.en: COPD exacerbation — salbutamol with a single dose of ipratropium, and consider dexamethasone
options.zh: COPD 急性加重——salbutamol 合用单剂量 ipratropium，并考虑 dexamethasone

options.en: Tension pneumothorax — prepare for needle decompression
options.zh: Tension pneumothorax（张力性气胸）——准备针刺减压

questions.explanationEn: A heavy smoking history, a barrel chest, pursed-lip breathing, a quiet chest with expiratory wheeze, purulent sputum and a baseline SpO2 already around 90% is an infective COPD exacerbation. The BC protocol gives salbutamol at all levels, and PCPs may add ipratropium as a single dose in the same nebulizer and consider dexamethasone. Option A has the wrong diagnosis: there is no orthopnea, no raised JVP, no peripheral edema and no crackles — the profile explicitly states the JVP and ankles are normal. Option B has the wrong diagnosis: no allergen, no urticaria, no angioedema, and a three-day course. Option D has the wrong diagnosis: his findings are bilateral and gradual, and he is neither hypotensive nor has a deviated trachea. Give high-flow oxygen for his current distress and titrate down afterwards.
questions.explanationZh: 大量吸烟史、桶状胸、缩唇呼吸、呼吸音低弱伴呼气性哮鸣、脓痰，加上基础 SpO2 本来就在 90% 左右，这是感染诱发的 COPD 急性加重。BC 协议规定所有级别都可给 salbutamol，PCP 可在同一雾化器中加入单剂量 ipratropium，并可考虑 dexamethasone。A 项诊断错了：无端坐呼吸、颈静脉压不高、无外周水肿、无湿啰音，题干还明写了颈静脉和踝部正常。B 项诊断错了：无过敏原、无荞麻疹、无血管性水肿，且病程长达三天。D 项诊断错了：他的体征是双侧且逐渐发展的，既不低血压也没有气管偏移。现阶段可先用高流量氧缓解窘迫，之后再逐步下调。

questions.questionEn: A 34-year-old woman returned yesterday from a 12-hour flight and now has sudden breathlessness and sharp right-sided chest pain that is worse on deep inspiration. HR 122, RR 28, BP 108/70, SpO2 90% on room air, temperature 37.2°C. Her chest is clear with equal air entry bilaterally, there is no rash and no wheeze, and her right calf is swollen and tender. She takes an oral contraceptive. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.questionZh: 一名 34 岁女性昨天刚结束 12 小时的长途飞行，现在突发气促并有右侧尖锐性胸痛，深吸气时加重。HR 122，RR 28，BP 108/70，室内空气下 SpO2 90%，体温 37.2°C。听诊双肺清晰、两侧进气量对称，无皮疹无哮鸣；右小腿肿胀且压痛。她在服口服避孕药。最可能的诊断是什么？

options.zh: Cardiogenic pulmonary edema（心源性肺水肿）

questions.explanationEn: Three risk factors line up — prolonged immobility, oral contraceptive use, and a swollen tender calf — and the presentation is the classic mismatch of pulmonary embolism: marked tachypnea and hypoxia with a clear chest on auscultation. Asthma is excluded: there is no wheeze and no asthma history, and asthma does not cause unilateral calf swelling. Pneumothorax is excluded: air entry is equal bilaterally, so no lung has collapsed. Cardiogenic pulmonary edema is excluded: there are no crackles, no raised JVP, no orthopnea and no cardiac history, and she is 34 years old. The hypoxia with a clear chest is the finding that should send you looking for the clot.
questions.explanationZh: 三个风险因素同时存在——长时间制动、口服避孕药、单侧小腿肿胀压痛，而且临床表现正是 pulmonary embolism（肺栓塞）典型的“不匹配”：呼吸很快、氧合很差，听诊却一片清晰。Asthma（哮喘）可以排除：无哮鸣音、无哮喘史，且哮喘不会引起单侧小腿肿胀。Pneumothorax（气胸）可以排除：两侧进气量对称，说明没有肺落下。Cardiogenic pulmonary edema（心源性肺水肿）可以排除：无湿啰音、颈静脉压不高、无端坐呼吸、无心脏病史，而且她才 34 岁。“听诊清晰却低氧”就是提示你去找血栓的那个关键点。

questions.questionEn: An 84-year-old man in acute cardiogenic pulmonary edema is awake, following commands and maintaining his own airway. RR 30, SpO2 88% on high-flow oxygen, marked accessory muscle use, BP 84/50, HR 116. He is not vomiting, there is no trauma and no suspicion of pneumothorax. Which PCP decision is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 84 岁男性处于急性心源性肺水肿，清醒、能遵从指令、能自主维持气道。RR 30，高流量氧下 SpO2 88%，辅助呼吸肌明显参与，BP 84/50，HR 116。无呕吐、无创伤、无气胸怪疑。下列哪一项 PCP 决策正确？

options.en: Apply CPAP starting at 5 cmH2O and titrate up to 10 cmH2O
options.zh: 上 CPAP，从 5 cmH2O 开始并逐步上调至 10 cmH2O

options.en: Withhold CPAP because his systolic blood pressure is below 90 mmHg
options.zh: 不用 CPAP，因为他的收缩压低于 90 mmHg

options.en: Withhold CPAP because pulmonary edema is not an indication for CPAP
options.zh: 不用 CPAP，因为肺水肿不是 CPAP 的适应症

options.en: Withhold CPAP because his respiratory rate is above 24
options.zh: 不用 CPAP，因为他的呼吸频率高于 24

questions.explanationEn: A systolic blood pressure below 90 mmHg is an explicit contraindication to CPAP, and his is 84 mmHg. Option A is the trap: he meets every physiological indication, but an indication never cancels a contraindication. Option C is factually wrong — congestive heart failure and acute cardiogenic pulmonary edema head the list of conditions for which CPAP should be considered. Option D inverts the criterion: RR greater than 24 is one of the required indications, not a contraindication. Support him with assisted ventilation by bag-valve mask; a PEEP valve would normally be considered here, but it must be removed if the patient is hypotensive below 90 systolic, so treat his blood pressure as the limiting factor and transport promptly.
questions.explanationZh: 收缩压低于 90 mmHg 是 CPAP 的明确禁忌，而他只有 84 mmHg。A 项是陷阱：他确实满足所有生理适应症，但适应症永远不能抵消禁忌症。C 项事实错误——充血性心力衰竭和急性心源性肺水肿恰恰是 CPAP 适应病种的第一项。D 项把标准搞反了：RR > 24 是必须满足的适应条件之一，而不是禁忌。处理上改用 BVM 辅助通气；通常这种情况会考虑加 PEEP 阀，但指引规定收缩压低于 90 时必须移除 PEEP 阀，所以要把血压当作限制因素，并尽快转运。

questions.questionEn: A 46-year-old man with a known asthma history called for shortness of breath 20 minutes after starting a new antibiotic. HR 130, RR 32, BP 86/52, SpO2 89% on room air. He has diffuse wheeze, a flushed itchy chest and mild tongue swelling. A first responder has already given salbutamol with no improvement. What is the most likely diagnosis, and what does it change?
questions.questionZh: 一名 46 岁、有明确 asthma 病史的男性，在开始服用一种新抗生素 20 分钟后因气促呼叫救护车。HR 130，RR 32，BP 86/52，室内空气下 SpO2 89%。双肺弥漫哮鸣音，胸部潮红并发痒，舌头轻度肿胀。急救员已给过 salbutamol，没有改善。最可能的诊断是什么？它会改变什么？

options.en: An asthma exacerbation — repeat salbutamol and add ipratropium
options.zh: asthma 急性发作——重复给 salbutamol 并加用 ipratropium

options.en: Anaphylaxis — give diphenhydramine first, then salbutamol
options.zh: Anaphylaxis（过敏性休克）——先给 diphenhydramine，再给 salbutamol

options.en: Anaphylaxis — give epinephrine first, then treat residual bronchospasm with salbutamol
options.zh: Anaphylaxis（过敏性休克）——先给 epinephrine，再用 salbutamol 处理残余的支气管痉挛

questions.explanationEn: A new drug exposure followed within minutes by wheeze, urticaria, angioedema and hypotension is anaphylaxis, not asthma — and the diagnosis changes which drug goes first. Options A and B treat the wrong diagnosis: hypotension, an itchy flushed rash and tongue swelling are not features of asthma, and his known asthma history is exactly the anchor that makes this error tempting. CPAP is additionally contraindicated at a systolic of 86 mmHg. Option C has the right diagnosis but the wrong order: the BC anaphylaxis protocol gives epinephrine first, adds a fluid bolus if he remains hypotensive, treats bronchospasm with salbutamol after epinephrine, and uses diphenhydramine to mitigate the medium-term histamine response, not as the first agent.
questions.explanationZh: 新用药物后几分钟内出现哮鸣、荞麻疹、血管性水肿和低血压，这是 anaphylaxis 而不是 asthma——诊断不同，第一个给的药就不同。A、B 两项治的是错的病：低血压、潮红发痒的皮疹和舌头肿胀都不是 asthma 的表现，而“他有哮喘史”正是让人错错的锦定效应；且收缩压 86 mmHg 时 CPAP 本身也是禁忌。C 项诊断对但顺序错：BC anaphylaxis 协议是先给 epinephrine，若仍低血压则补液，在 epinephrine 之后用 salbutamol 处理支气管痉挛，diphenhydramine 是用来减轻中期组胺反应的辅助药，不是首选。

questions.questionEn: A 30-year-old trauma patient is in severe respiratory distress. Breath sounds are absent on the left and normal on the right, the trachea is deviated to the right, the neck veins are distended, HR is 138 and BP is 72/50. Which condition does this combination of findings indicate?
questions.questionZh: 一名 30 岁创伤患者处于严重呼吸窘迫。左侧呼吸音消失、右侧正常，气管向右偏移，颈静脉怡张，HR 138，BP 72/50。这组体征提示哪一种疾病？
questions.explanationEn: Unilaterally absent air entry plus tracheal deviation away from the affected side plus distended neck veins plus obstructive shock defines tension pneumothorax, which the BC guidelines list among the treatable causes of cardiac arrest. A simple pneumothorax gives unilaterally absent air entry but no tracheal shift, no distended neck veins and no hypotension. Cardiac tamponade also produces distended neck veins with hypotension, but breath sounds remain equal and the trachea stays midline. A massive hemothorax also silences one hemithorax with hypotension, but the neck veins are typically flat from blood loss and the trachea is not pushed away under pressure. Tension pneumothorax is the one on this list that must be relieved immediately.
questions.explanationZh: 单侧呼吸音消失 + 气管向健侧偏移 + 颈静脉怡张 + 棗阻性休克，这四项合起来就是 tension pneumothorax（张力性气胸），BC 指引把它列为可逆转的心脏骤停病因之一。Simple pneumothorax（单纯性气胸）也会单侧呼吸音消失，但不会有气管偏移、颈静脉怡张和低血压。Cardiac tamponade（心包填塞）同样有颈静脉怡张加低血压，但两侧呼吸音对称、气管居中。Massive hemothorax（大量血胸）也会让一侧胸腔呼吸音消失并伴低血压，但因为失血，颈静脉通常是塌陷的，气管也不会被压力推开。四个选项中，只有张力性气胸需要立即减压。

questions.questionEn: A 58-year-old man has 40 minutes of central crushing chest pressure radiating to his left jaw, with nausea and a cold sweat. HR 96, RR 20, BP 148/90, SpO2 96% on room air, temperature 36.7°C. The pain is unchanged by position and by deep breathing, and his chest wall is not tender. He has hypertension and smokes. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.questionZh: 一名 58 岁男性胸骨后压迫性疼痛已 40 分钟，疼痛放射到左下颌，伴恶心和冷汗。HR 96，RR 20，BP 148/90，室内空气下 SpO2 96%，体温 36.7°C。改变体位和深呼吸都不影响疼痛，胸壁无压痛。他有高血压，吸烟。最可能的诊断是什么？

options.zh: Acute coronary syndrome（急性冠脉综合征）
Musculoskeletal chest wall pain（胸壁肌骨疼痛）

questions.explanationEn: Pressure-type pain lasting 40 minutes with jaw radiation, nausea and diaphoresis, in a 58-year-old smoker with hypertension, is acute coronary syndrome until proven otherwise; manage under the cardiac chest pain protocol with position of comfort, oxygen to keep SpO2 at or above 94%, chewed ASA, nitroglycerin if not contraindicated, and prompt transport. Pericarditis is excluded: its pain is sharp, worse lying flat and eased by sitting forward, and this pain is explicitly unchanged by position. Musculoskeletal pain is excluded: the chest wall is explicitly not tender and there is no trauma or unaccustomed exertion. Gastroesophageal reflux is excluded: reflux is burning, related to meals or lying down, and does not radiate to the jaw with diaphoresis — and even where the two overlap, the safe reading of this constellation is cardiac.
questions.explanationZh: 持续 40 分钟的压迫性疼痛，放射至下颌，伴恶心和大汗，发生在一个 58 岁、有高血压且吸烟的男性身上，在排除之前就是 acute coronary syndrome（急性冠脉综合征）；按心源性胸痛协议处理：舌适体位、给氧使 SpO2 ≥ 94%、嘶服 ASA、无禁忌时给 nitroglycerin，并尽快转运。Pericarditis（心包炎）可以排除：心包炎的疼痛是尖锐性的、平躺时加重、前倾坐位缓解，而本例明写体位不影响疼痛。Musculoskeletal chest wall pain（胸壁肌骨疼痛）可以排除：题干明写胸壁无压痛，也没有创伤或过度用力史。Gastroesophageal reflux（胃食管反流）可以排除：反流是烧灼感，与进餐或平躺相关，不会放射到下颌并伴大汗；即使两者表现重叠，安全的判读也是当心源性处理。

questions.questionEn: A 68-year-old man with poorly controlled hypertension has sudden severe tearing chest pain that began between his shoulder blades and has moved down toward his abdomen. HR 104, RR 22, SpO2 96% on room air, temperature 36.9°C. His blood pressure is 196/104 in the right arm and 148/88 in the left, and his left radial pulse is noticeably weaker. His chest is clear with equal air entry, and there is no rash and no chest wall tenderness. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.questionZh: 一名 68 岁、高血压控制不佳的男性突发剧烈的擕裂样疼痛，疼痛从肩胛间开始，向下移行到腹部。HR 104，RR 22，室内空气下 SpO2 96%，体温 36.9°C。右臂血压 196/104，左臂 148/88，左侧校动脉明显较弱。听诊双肺清晰、进气量对称，无皮疹，胸壁无压痛。最可能的诊断是什么？

options.zh: Acute coronary syndrome（急性冠脉综合征）

questions.explanationEn: Abrupt tearing interscapular pain that migrates, together with an inter-arm systolic difference of nearly 50 mmHg and an asymmetric radial pulse, is aortic dissection. This matters enormously, because the reflex cardiac chest pain pathway of ASA and nitroglycerin is the wrong path here: the priorities are recognition, gentle handling, minimal movement, and rapid transport with early notification. Acute coronary syndrome is excluded: its pain is pressure-like and builds over minutes rather than tearing and migrating, and it does not create an inter-arm blood pressure difference. Pulmonary embolism is excluded: it produces pleuritic pain with hypoxia and tachypnea, and his SpO2 is 96% with no venous thromboembolism risk factor described. Pericarditis is excluded: its pain is positional and sharp, often after a viral illness, and it never causes unequal pulses.
questions.explanationZh: 突发的、从肩胛间开始并向下移行的擕裂样疼痛，加上双臂收缩压相差接近 50 mmHg 和校动脉不对称，这是 aortic dissection（主动脉夹层）。这个诊断至关重要，因为习惯性的“ASA + nitroglycerin”心源性胸痛路径在这里是错的；重点是识别、轻柔搬动、尽量减少活动，并快速转运、提前通知接收医院。Acute coronary syndrome 可以排除：冠脉疼痛是压迫性的、数分钟内逐渐加重，不会“擕裂”也不会移行，更不会造成双臂血压差。Pulmonary embolism 可以排除：肺栓塞表现为胸膜性疼痛伴低氧和呼吸增快，而他 SpO2 96%，也没有任何静脉血栓风险因素。Pericarditis 可以排除：心包炎疼痛与体位相关、呈尖锐性，多跟在病毒感染之后，而且绝不会造成脉搏不对称。

questions.questionEn: A 31-year-old man has two days of sharp central chest pain that is worse when he lies flat and eases when he sits forward. It is also worse on deep inspiration. HR 100, RR 20, BP 124/78, SpO2 98% on room air, temperature 37.9°C. He had an influenza-like illness last week. His chest is clear with equal air entry, there is no chest wall tenderness and no leg swelling. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.questionZh: 一名 31 岁男性胸骨后尖锐性疼痛已两天，平躺时加重、前倾坐起时减轻，深吸气时也加重。HR 100，RR 20，BP 124/78，室内空气下 SpO2 98%，体温 37.9°C。他上周得过一场流感样疾病。听诊双肺清晰、进气量对称，胸壁无压痛，双下肢无肿胀。最可能的诊断是什么？

options.zh: Acute coronary syndrome（急性冠脉综合征）

questions.explanationEn: Sharp pain that is worse lying flat and relieved by sitting forward, following a viral illness, with a low-grade fever, is pericarditis: the inflamed pericardium is compressed when supine and released when the patient leans forward. Acute coronary syndrome is excluded: coronary pain is pressure-like, not positional, and is not eased by leaning forward. Pulmonary embolism is excluded: his SpO2 is 98% with a normal respiratory rate, and there is no leg swelling or other risk factor. Pneumothorax is excluded: air entry is equal bilaterally and the onset was gradual over two days. Note that positional relief is reassuring but does not license you to skip a cardiac work-up in an older or higher-risk patient.
questions.explanationZh: 尖锐性疼痛、平躺加重、前倾缓解，且发生在一场病毒感染之后并伴低热，这是 pericarditis（心包炎）：发炎的心包在仰卧时受压、前倾时得到释放。Acute coronary syndrome 可以排除：冠脉疼痛是压迫性的，不随体位变化，也不会因前倾而缓解。Pulmonary embolism 可以排除：SpO2 98%、呼吸频率正常，且无下肢肿胀或其他风险因素。Pneumothorax 可以排除：两侧进气量对称，且病程是两天内逐渐发展而非突发。需要提醒的是：“前倾能缓解”虽然令人安心，但在年长或高风险患者身上仍不能据此跳过心源性评估。

questions.questionEn: A 15-year-old boy helped carry heavy boxes yesterday and today has left-sided chest pain that he can point to with one finger. HR 78, RR 16, BP 118/72, SpO2 99% on room air, temperature 36.6°C. The pain is reproduced exactly when the paramedic presses over the left costochondral junction and when he raises his arm above his head. Air entry is equal bilaterally, and there is no diaphoresis, no shortness of breath, no fever and no calf swelling. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.questionZh: 一名 15 岁男生昨天帮忙搬了很多重箱子，今天出现左侧胸痛，能用一根手指指出疼点。HR 78，RR 16，BP 118/72，室内空气下 SpO2 99%，体温 36.6°C。按压左侧肋软骨交界处以及他把手臂举过头顶时，疼痛能被完全重现。两侧进气量对称，无大汗、无气促、无发热、无小腿肿胀。最可能的诊断是什么？

options.zh: Musculoskeletal chest wall pain（肋软骨交界处的胸壁肌骨疼痛）

questions.explanationEn: Pain the patient can localize with one finger, reproduced exactly by palpation and by arm movement, after unaccustomed lifting, with entirely normal vital signs, is costochondral chest wall pain. Pericarditis is excluded: its pain is worse lying flat and eased by sitting forward, usually follows a viral illness with fever, and is not reproduced by pressing on the chest wall. Spontaneous pneumothorax is excluded: air entry is equal bilaterally and his SpO2 is 99%. Pulmonary embolism is excluded: normal respiratory rate, normal saturation, no calf swelling and no risk factor. One caution: reproducibility on palpation lowers the probability of a serious cause but never excludes one on its own — it is the combination with normal vitals, no autonomic features and no risk factors that makes this conclusion safe.
questions.explanationZh: 疼痛能用一根手指定位、按压和手臂活动能完全重现、发生在不习惯的搬重物之后，且生命体征完全正常，这是肋软骨交界处的胸壁肌骨疼痛。Pericarditis（心包炎）可以排除：心包炎平躺加重、前倾缓解，多跟在发热的病毒感染之后，且不能被按压重现。Spontaneous pneumothorax（自发性气胸）可以排除：两侧进气量对称，SpO2 99%。Pulmonary embolism（肺栓塞）可以排除：呼吸频率正常、氧合正常、无小腿肿胀、无风险因素。一点提醒：“按下去能重现疼痛”只能降低严重病因的概率，单靠它永远不能排除心源性；真正让这个结论安全的，是它同时伴随正常生命体征、无自主神经症状、无风险因素。

questions.questionEn: A 74-year-old woman has 45 minutes of epigastric burning with nausea and feels 'clammy and exhausted'. She firmly denies any chest pain. HR 52, RR 20, BP 96/58, SpO2 95% on room air, temperature 36.8°C. She is pale and diaphoretic, her abdomen is soft and non-tender, and she has type 2 diabetes. Which diagnosis and which PCP action is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 74 岁女性上腹烧灼感已 45 分钟，伴恶心，自述“黏湻又精疲力竭”。她坚决否认有任何胸痛。HR 52，RR 20，BP 96/58，室内空气下 SpO2 95%，体温 36.8°C。面色苍白、大汗淋漓，腹部柔软无压痛，有 2 型糖尿病。下列哪一项的诊断和 PCP 处置是正确的？

options.en: Gastroesophageal reflux — reassure her and offer transport
options.zh: Gastroesophageal reflux（胃食管反流）——安抚她并提供转运

options.en: Acute myocardial infarction — manage under the cardiac chest pain protocol and obtain a 12-lead ECG, but withhold nitroglycerin because her systolic BP is below 110 mmHg and her heart rate is below 50
options.zh: Acute myocardial infarction（急性心肌梗死）——按心源性胸痛协议处理并采集 12 导联心电图，但不给 nitroglycerin，因为她的收缩压低于 110 mmHg、心率低于 50

options.en: Cholecystitis — position of comfort and consider ondansetron
options.zh: Cholecystitis（胆囊炎）——舌适体位并考虑 ondansetron

options.en: Gastric ulcer — transport for assessment with no further intervention
options.zh: Gastric ulcer（胃溃疡）——转运到院评估，不做其他处置

questions.explanationEn: Epigastric discomfort with pallor, diaphoresis, bradycardia and hypotension in an older diabetic woman is an atypical myocardial infarction — often inferior — until proven otherwise; age and diabetic neuropathy blunt the classic pain, so 'no chest pain' does not lower your suspicion. The bradycardia and hypotension fit inferior wall involvement, and both of the BC nitroglycerin contraindications are present: systolic BP below 110 mmHg and heart rate below 50. Option A misses an infarct and offers reassurance instead. Option C is excluded because her abdomen is explicitly soft and non-tender and she has no fever or right upper quadrant findings. Option D is excluded for the same reason, and neither a reflux nor an ulcer explains a heart rate of 52 with a systolic of 96 and diaphoresis. Give ASA per protocol, keep her at rest and transport.
questions.explanationZh: 上腹不适伴苍白、大汗、心动过缓和低血压，发生在年长糖尿病女性身上，在排除之前就是不典型心肌梗死（常为下壁）；年龄和糖尿病神经病变会遈蔽典型疼痛，所以“没有胸痛”不能降低你的警惕。心动过缓加低血压符合下壁受累，而且 BC 的两项 nitroglycerin 禁忌同时存在：收缩压低于 110 mmHg、心率低于 50。A 项会漏掉一个梗死，只给安抚。C 项可以排除：题干明写腹部柔软无压痛，也没有发热或右上腹体征。D 项同理可排除，而且无论反流还是溃疡，都解释不了 HR 52、收缩压 96 并伴大汗。处理：按协议给 ASA，保持静止，尽快转运。

questions.questionEn: A 62-year-old man has 30 minutes of central chest pressure with diaphoresis. HR 44, RR 18, BP 88/56, SpO2 95% on room air. He states he has taken no medications at all today and the profile records nothing else. ASA has been given. A crew member asks about nitroglycerin. Which response is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 62 岁男性胸骨后压迫感已 30 分钟，伴大汗。HR 44，RR 18，BP 88/56，室内空气下 SpO2 95%。他表示今天没有服用任何药物，患者资料中也没有其他记录。ASA 已经给过。同事问是否要给 nitroglycerin。哪一项回答正确？

options.en: Give nitroglycerin 0.4 mg sublingually because the pain is clearly cardiac
options.zh: 给 nitroglycerin 0.4 mg 舌下含服，因为疼痛显然是心源性的

options.en: Give nitroglycerin only after a 250 mL fluid bolus has raised the blood pressure
options.zh: 先输 250 mL 液体把血压拉上去，再给 nitroglycerin

options.en: Withhold nitroglycerin — his systolic BP is below 110 mmHg and his heart rate is below 50
options.zh: 不给 nitroglycerin——他的收缩压低于 110 mmHg，且心率低于 50

options.en: Withhold nitroglycerin only because he may have taken a phosphodiesterase inhibitor
options.zh: 不给 nitroglycerin，唯一理由是他可能服用过磷酸二酯酶抑制剂

questions.explanationEn: Two independent contraindications from the BC nitroglycerin monograph are present at once: systolic BP below 110 mmHg and heart rate below 50. Option A ignores both and would drop his preload further in a patient who is already hypotensive. Option B invents a workaround the protocol does not contain — there is no 'bolus first, then nitro' pathway. Option D names a genuine contraindication that is not established here: he states he has taken no medications today and nothing else is recorded, and the profile states abnormalities explicitly, so it cannot be the reason. Bradycardia with hypotension and chest pressure should raise suspicion of inferior wall involvement; keep him at rest, obtain vascular access at PCP level, consider Entonox for pain, and transport.
questions.explanationZh: BC nitroglycerin 药典中的两项独立禁忌同时存在：收缩压低于 110 mmHg、心率低于 50。A 项两项都无视，会在本已低血压的患者身上进一步降低前负荷。B 项凭空造了一条协议里没有的路径——不存在“先补液再给硝酸甘油”这种做法。D 项提到的确实是真禁忌，但本例并未成立：他明确说今天没吃任何药，资料也没有其他记录，而考试资料一定会把异常写出来，所以它不能作为理由。心动过缓加低血压加胸部压迫感应警惕下壁受累；保持静止，PCP 开放静脉通路，疼痛可考虑 Entonox，并尽快转运。

questions.questionEn: Which feature most strongly favours pulmonary embolism over acute coronary syndrome in a patient with chest pain?
questions.questionZh: 在一名胸痛患者身上，哪一项特征最支持 pulmonary embolism（肺栓塞）而不是 acute coronary syndrome（急性冠脉综合征）？

options.en: Sharp pleuritic pain with tachypnea, hypoxia and a swollen tender calf
options.zh: 尖锐的胸膜性疼痛，伴呼吸增快、低氧，且单侧小腿肿胀压痛

options.en: Pain radiating to the left arm
Relief of the pain after nitroglycerin
options.zh: 给 nitroglycerin 后疼痛缓解

options.en: Pain reproduced by pressing on the sternum
options.zh: 按压胸骨时疼痛被重现

questions.explanationEn: Pleuritic pain with tachypnea, hypoxia and unilateral calf swelling points to a clot: the leg is the source and the lung is the consequence, and the hypoxia is usually out of proportion to what you hear on auscultation. Option B favours acute coronary syndrome, not pulmonary embolism. Option C is unreliable in both directions and must never be used as a diagnostic test — nitroglycerin can relieve oesophageal spasm and can fail to relieve a genuine infarct. Option D suggests a chest wall cause and argues against both diagnoses, but on its own it excludes neither.
questions.explanationZh: 胸膜性疼痛伴呼吸增快、低氧和单侧小腿肿胀，指向血栓：腿是来源，肺是后果，而且低氧程度往往与听诊所见不成比例。B 项支持的是冠脉综合征而不是肺栓塞。C 项两个方向都不可靠，绝对不能当诊断性试验：nitroglycerin 可以缓解食管痉挛，也可以对真正的梗死无效。D 项提示胸壁性病因，它同时不支持两个诊断，但单靠它哪个都排除不了。

questions.questionEn: A 70-year-old man with severe COPD suddenly becomes much more short of breath during a coughing fit, with new sharp left-sided chest pain. HR 118, RR 30, BP 104/68, SpO2 85% on 4 L/min by nasal cannula, temperature 36.7°C. Air entry is absent on the left and present on the right, the trachea is midline, and there is no fever, no change in his sputum and no leg swelling. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.questionZh: 一名 70 岁、重度 COPD 的男性在一阵剧烈咳嗽中突然气促加重，并新出现左侧尖锐性胸痛。HR 118，RR 30，BP 104/68，鼻导管 4 L/min 下 SpO2 85%，体温 36.7°C。左侧呼吸音消失、右侧存在，气管居中；无发热，痰的性状没变，双下肢无肿胀。最可能的诊断是什么？

options.zh: Cardiogenic pulmonary edema（心源性肺水肿）
Secondary spontaneous pneumothorax（继发性自发性气胸）

questions.explanationEn: An instantaneous step-change in a COPD patient, with new unilateral pleuritic pain and unilaterally absent air entry, is a secondary spontaneous pneumothorax from rupture of an emphysematous bulla during coughing. A COPD exacerbation is excluded: those build over days, produce bilateral wheeze and usually come with a change in sputum, and nothing here is bilateral while the sputum is explicitly unchanged. Pneumonia is excluded: no fever, no sputum change, and the onset was instantaneous rather than over days. Cardiogenic pulmonary edema is excluded: no orthopnea, no crackles, no raised jugular venous pressure and no ankle swelling described, and the absence of comment means treat them as normal. Watch continuously for tension: a rising heart rate, falling blood pressure, tracheal deviation and distended neck veins.
questions.explanationZh: 一个 COPD 患者病情在一瞬间台阶式恶化，并新出现单侧胸膜性疼痛和单侧呼吸音消失，这是继发性自发性气胸——咳嗽时肺气肿大疱破裂。COPD 急性加重可以排除：它在数天内逐渐加重，表现为双侧哮鸣，通常伴痰的性状改变；而本例体征是单侧的，题干又明写痰没变。Pneumonia（肺炎）可以排除：无发热、痰无变化，且起病是瞬间而非数天。Cardiogenic pulmonary edema（心源性肺水肿）可以排除：无端坐呼吸、无湿啰音、未提及颈静脉压升高或踝部水肿，没写就按正常处理。全程监控是否转为张力性：心率上升、血压下降、气管偏移、颈静脉怡张。

questions.questionEn: A 58-year-old man has 40 minutes of central chest pressure. His 12-lead ECG shows ST elevation in leads II, III and aVF with reciprocal ST depression in I and aVL. HR 48, BP 88/54, SpO2 96% on room air. Which interpretation and consequence is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 58 岁男性胸骨后压迫感已 40 分钟。他的 12 导联心电图显示 II、III、aVF 导联 ST 段抬高，并且 I 和 aVL 出现对应性 ST 段压低。HR 48，BP 88/54，室内空气下 SpO2 96%。下列哪一项的判读和后续处理是正确的？

options.en: Anterior STEMI — nitroglycerin is indicated because the pain is cardiac
options.zh: 前壁 STEMI——因为疼痛是心源性的，所以应该给 nitroglycerin

options.en: Inferior STEMI — bradycardia and hypotension are common, and nitroglycerin is contraindicated at this blood pressure and heart rate
options.zh: 下壁 STEMI——心动过缓和低血压很常见，而且在这个血压和心率下 nitroglycerin 是禁忌的

options.en: Pericarditis — the ST elevation is diffuse
options.zh: Pericarditis（心包炎）——ST 段抬高是弥漫性的

options.en: Left bundle branch block — no acute interpretation is possible
options.zh: 左束支传导阻滞——无法做出急性期判读

questions.explanationEn: Leads II, III and aVF look at the inferior wall, and reciprocal depression in I and aVL supports a true inferior STEMI rather than an artefact. Inferior infarcts frequently involve the right ventricle and produce vagally mediated bradycardia, which makes these patients preload-dependent — nitroglycerin drops preload and can cause profound hypotension. Independently of that physiology, the BC monograph contraindicates nitroglycerin at a systolic below 110 mmHg and a heart rate below 50, and both are present. Option A misreads the leads: the anterior wall is V1 to V4. Option C is wrong because pericarditis produces diffuse concave ST elevation without reciprocal depression. Option D is wrong because no bundle branch block criteria are described, and 'no interpretation possible' would still not licence nitroglycerin at this blood pressure.
questions.explanationZh: II、III、aVF 看的是下壁，I 和 aVL 的对应性压低支持这是真正的下壁 STEMI 而不是伪差。下壁梗死常常累及右心室，并通过迷走神经反射引起心动过缓，这类患者高度依赖前负荷——nitroglycerin 降低前负荷，可能导致严重低血压。抛开这层生理不谈，BC 药典本身就规定收缩压低于 110 mmHg、心率低于 50 时禁用 nitroglycerin，而两项都成立。A 项读错了导联：前壁是 V1–V4。C 项错在 pericarditis 的 ST 抬高是弥漫、凹面向上的，且没有对应性压低。D 项错在题干并未描述任何束支阻滞标准，而且即使“无法判读”，在这个血压下也不能给 nitroglycerin。

questions.questionEn: A 14-year-old with type 1 diabetes becomes confused and combative during a school basketball game. HR 118, RR 20, BP 118/72, SpO2 97% on room air, temperature 36.6°C. His skin is cool, pale and drenched in sweat, his pupils are equal and reactive, there is no head injury and no unilateral weakness. He took his usual morning insulin and skipped lunch. Which condition is he most likely suffering from?
questions.questionZh: 一名 14 岁、1 型糖尿病学生在校队篮球比赛中变得神智混乱、易激惹。HR 118，RR 20，BP 118/72，室内空气下 SpO2 97%，体温 36.6°C。皮肤冰凉、苍白、大汗淋漓，双瞄孔等大等圆对光反射存在，无头部外伤，无单侧肢体无力。他早上照常注射了胰岛素，但没吃午饭。他最可能患的是哪一种疾病？
questions.explanationEn: Combative confusion with cool, pale, sweaty skin in an insulin-treated diabetic who exercised on a missed meal is hypoglycemia. The BC diabetic emergencies guideline requires a blood glucose measurement on every patient with a decreased level of consciousness and correction when it is below 4.0 mmol/L. Stroke is excluded: there is no facial droop, no unilateral weakness and no speech deficit, and abnormal neurological findings would have been stated. Postictal state is excluded: no seizure was witnessed, there is no tongue biting or incontinence, and postictal patients are drowsy and slow rather than diaphoretic and combative. Opioid overdose is excluded: his pupils are equal and reactive rather than pinpoint, and his respirations are 20 and adequate rather than depressed.
questions.explanationZh: 一个用胰岛素的糖尿病孩子漏吃一顶饭又去运动，现在神智混乱、易激惹，皮肤冰凉苍白大汗，这是 hypoglycemia（低血糖）。BC 糖尿病急症指引要求对每一个意识下降的患者测血糖，低于 4.0 mmol/L 就要纠正。Stroke（卒中）可以排除：无口角歪斜、无单侧无力、无言语障碍，神经系统异常如果有一定会写出来。Postictal state（癘疫后状态）可以排除：无人目击抽搐，无咬舌或尿失禁，而且癘疫后患者是嵊睡迟钝而不是大汗兼易激惹。Opioid overdose（阿片类过量）可以排除：瞄孔等大对光反射存在而非针尖样，呼吸 20 次/分且潮气量足够，没有呼吸抑制。

questions.questionEn: A 78-year-old woman was well at breakfast and 30 minutes ago suddenly could not speak properly. HR 92 and irregularly irregular, RR 18, BP 186/98, SpO2 96% on room air, temperature 36.9°C, blood glucose 6.8 mmol/L. Her right arm drifts down when both arms are held out, her face is asymmetric on the right, and she is alert. She takes an anticoagulant for atrial fibrillation. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.questionZh: 一名 78 岁女性早餐时还一切如常，30 分钟前突然说话含糊不清。HR 92、绝对不规则，RR 18，BP 186/98，室内空气下 SpO2 96%，体温 36.9°C，血糖 6.8 mmol/L。双臂平伸时右臂下良，右侧面部不对称，神智清醒。她因 atrial fibrillation（房颤）在服抗凝药。最可能的诊断是什么？

options.zh: Todd's paralysis（癘疫后一过性瘦痪）

options.en: Delirium from a urinary tract infection
options.zh: 尿路感染引起的 delirium（谵妄）

questions.explanationEn: An abrupt onset with focal deficits — arm drift, facial asymmetry and a speech change — in an alert patient with atrial fibrillation and a normal blood glucose is a stroke until proven otherwise. Recognize with FAST-VAN, keep SpO2 at or above 94%, position her, and transport promptly with notification en route, because time is the treatment. Hypoglycemia is excluded: her glucose is 6.8 mmol/L, and this is precisely why the guideline mandates a blood glucose check before committing to the stroke pathway — hypoglycemia can mimic a stroke perfectly. Todd's paralysis is excluded: it requires a preceding seizure, and none is described. Urinary tract infection delirium is excluded: it develops over days with fluctuating attention and does not produce a fixed focal deficit, and she is afebrile and alert.
questions.explanationZh: 突然起病、存在局灼体征（臂下良、面部不对称、言语改变），患者神智清醒、有房颤、血糖正常，这在排除之前就是急性卒中。用 FAST-VAN 识别，给氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%，摆好体位，尽快转运并在途中通知接收医院——时间就是治疗。Hypoglycemia（低血糖）可以排除：血糖 6.8 mmol/L；而这恰恰就是指引要求“走卒中路径前先测血糖”的原因——低血糖能完美模拟卒中。Todd's paralysis 可以排除：它必须有前驱的癘疫发作，而题干没有。尿路感染引起的 delirium 可以排除：它在数天内发展、注意力波动，不会造成固定的局灼体征，而且她不发热且神智清醒。

questions.questionEn: An 81-year-old man has been 'not himself' for two days: drowsy, confused about the date, and off his food. HR 116, RR 26, BP 92/54, SpO2 93% on room air, temperature 36.2°C, blood glucose 7.4 mmol/L. His skin is warm and flushed with a capillary refill of 4 seconds, his urine smells strongly, and he has no focal weakness and no head injury. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.questionZh: 一名 81 岁男性连续两天“不对劲”：嵊睡、说不清日期、不想吃东西。HR 116，RR 26，BP 92/54，室内空气下 SpO2 93%，体温 36.2°C，血糖 7.4 mmol/L。皮肤温热潮红，毛细血管再充盈时间 4 秒，尿液气味很重；无局灼无力，无头部外伤。最可能的诊断是什么？
questions.explanationEn: New confusion developing over two days, with tachycardia, tachypnea, hypotension, warm flushed skin and a capillary refill of 4 seconds, is sepsis. Crucially, older adults with sepsis are frequently normothermic or hypothermic, so a temperature of 36.2°C does not rule it out — it is if anything a worse sign. Dementia is excluded: dementia develops over months to years and does not cause a new tachycardia with hypotension; an acute change in a person with dementia is delirium on top of dementia and still demands a cause. Stroke is excluded: there is no focal deficit, and stroke does not produce this systemic circulatory picture. Hypoglycemia is excluded: the glucose is 7.4 mmol/L. Give oxygen to keep SpO2 at or above 94% and transport as an unstable patient.
questions.explanationZh: 两天内新出现的神智改变，伴心动过速、呼吸增快、低血压、皮肤温热潮红、毛细血管再充盈 4 秒，这是 sepsis（脓毒症）。关键在于：老年脓毒症患者很多体温正常甚至偏低，所以 36.2°C 不能用来排除脓毒症，反而提示预后更差。Dementia（痴呆）可以排除：痴呆是数月到数年的进程，不会造成新发的心动过速加低血压；痴呆患者突然变差，那是在痴呆基础上叠加了 delirium（谵妄），仍然必须找病因。Stroke（卒中）可以排除：无局灼体征，而且卒中不会造成这种全身循环表现。Hypoglycemia（低血糖）可以排除：血糖 7.4 mmol/L。处理：给氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%，按不稳定患者转运。

questions.questionEn: A 26-year-old is found unresponsive to voice and responds only to pain. RR 6 and shallow, HR 58, BP 104/62, SpO2 84% on room air, temperature 35.9°C, blood glucose 5.6 mmol/L. Pupils are 1 mm bilaterally. There is no trauma. Which diagnosis and which PCP management is correct?
questions.questionZh: 一名 26 岁患者被发现呼喊不应，仅对疼痛刺激有反应。RR 6 且浅，HR 58，BP 104/62，室内空气下 SpO2 84%，体温 35.9°C，血糖 5.6 mmol/L。双瞄孔 1 mm。无创伤。下列哪一项的诊断和 PCP 处置是正确的？

options.zh: Hypoglycemia（低血糖）——静脉给 D10W 10–25 g

options.en: Opioid overdose — manage the airway, support ventilations and give naloxone; if unconsciousness and apnea continue, consider vascular access and intravenous naloxone
options.zh: Opioid overdose（阿片类过量）——管理气道、辅助通气并给 naloxone；若持续昆迷且呼吸停止，考虑建立静脉通路并静脉给 naloxone

options.en: Sympathomimetic toxicity — cool aggressively and restrain
options.zh: Sympathomimetic toxicity（拟交感神经药物中毒）——积极降温并约束

options.en: Postictal state — position semi-prone and observe
options.zh: Postictal state（癘疫后状态）——半俯卧位并观察

questions.explanationEn: A decreased level of consciousness with a depressed respiratory drive shown by both a slow rate and a small tidal volume, plus pinpoint pupils, bradycardia and hypothermia, is the opioid toxidrome exactly as the BC guideline describes it. Manage the airway with positioning, suctioning and an adjunct as needed, support ventilations, keep SpO2 at or above 94%, check the blood glucose, and give naloxone; the PCP addition is intravenous naloxone if unconsciousness and apnea persist. Option A is excluded because the glucose is 5.6 mmol/L — the guideline still requires you to measure it, which is why it appears in the profile. Option C is the mirror-image toxidrome: stimulants give dilated pupils, tachycardia, hypertension and hyperthermia. Option D is excluded because a postictal patient breathes adequately and has normal reactive pupils, and 'observe' would leave this patient hypoxic.
questions.explanationZh: 意识下降伴呼吸驱动受抑（频率慢且潮气量小）、针尖样瞄孔、心动过缓、低体温，这完全符合 BC 指引描述的阿片类中毒综合征。处理：用体位、吸引和气道辅助具管理气道，辅助通气，维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%，测血糖，给 naloxone；PCP 额外可在持续昆迷且呼吸停止时建立静脉通路、静脉给 naloxone。A 项可排除：血糖 5.6 mmol/L；但指引仍要求必须测血糖，这也是题干给出血糖值的原因。C 项是完全相反的中毒综合征：兴奋剂导致瞄孔散大、心动过速、高血压、高热。D 项可排除：癘疫后患者呼吸是足够的、瞄孔正常对光，而且“只观察”会让这个患者一直缺氧。

questions.questionEn: A 17-year-old at an outdoor music event is agitated, shouting and repeatedly trying to stand. HR 158, RR 28, BP 178/104, SpO2 97% on room air, temperature 40.1°C, blood glucose 6.2 mmol/L. His pupils are 7 mm and reactive and his skin is hot and drenched with sweat. There is no head injury. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.questionZh: 一名 17 岁青少年在露天音乐活动上出现躁动、大喊大叫、反复想要站起来。HR 158，RR 28，BP 178/104，室内空气下 SpO2 97%，体温 40.1°C，血糖 6.2 mmol/L。双瞄孔 7 mm、对光反射存在，皮肤灼热并大汗淋漓。无头部外伤。最可能的诊断是什么？

options.zh: Sympathomimetic toxicity（拟交感神经/兴奋剂中毒）

questions.explanationEn: Agitation with tachycardia, hypertension, hyperthermia, dilated reactive pupils and diaphoresis is the sympathomimetic toxidrome. Opioid overdose is excluded because it is the mirror image: bradypnea, pinpoint pupils, hypotension and hypothermia. Hypoglycemia is excluded because the glucose is 6.2 mmol/L, and it is measured here precisely so it can be ruled out. Heat exhaustion is excluded because heat-exhausted patients have a normal or only mildly raised core temperature with an intact mental status; a temperature of 40.1°C with an altered mental status is in heat-stroke territory, and here the drug is driving it. Aggressive cooling is still required alongside managing the agitation, and the guidelines direct a blood glucose measurement on any patient with a decreased level of consciousness.
questions.explanationZh: 躁动伴心动过速、高血压、高热、瞄孔散大但对光反射存在、大汗，这是拟交感神经中毒综合征。Opioid overdose（阿片类过量）可以排除，因为它是完全相反的镜像：呼吸慢、瞄孔针尖、低血压、低体温。Hypoglycemia（低血糖）可以排除，因为血糖 6.2 mmol/L；题干给出血糖值就是为了让你把它排掉。Heat exhaustion（热衰竭）可以排除，因为热衰竭患者核心体温正常或仅轻度升高且神智清楚；40.1°C 加神智改变已经是热射病的范畴，而本例是药物推高的。处理上除了控制躁动，仍需积极降温；指引要求对任何意识下降的患者测血糖。
